newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares mark time amid budget uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares mark time amid budget uncertainty.

text.p: Danish share prices closed virtually unchanged on Friday with trade restrained while the government retunes its 1997 budget plans.

"Complications with the budget give people an excuse to wait on the sidelines. Something needs to happen, for example a resolution of the budget issue, and then we'll be ready to rise again," a dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index crept up 0.02 point to 127.46 in overall bourse turnover of 616 million crowns. Its December future rose 0.30 point to 127.95 with 65 contracts, each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
